description: An agent-based model simulating the spread of mask-wearing behavior through social networks, influenced by social connections and government interventions.

behaviors.name: adopt_mask_wearing
behaviors.description: Agents decide to wear a mask based on social influence and personal risk perception.
behaviors.algorithm: If social_influence > influence_threshold or risk_perception is high, adopt mask-wearing.

behaviors.name: influence_others
behaviors.description: Agents influence others in their network to adopt mask-wearing.
behaviors.algorithm: Calculate influence based on connection strength and mask_wearing_status.

behaviors.name: respond_to_influence
behaviors.description: Agents respond to the influence of others within their social network.
behaviors.algorithm: Probability of adopting mask-wearing increases with the number of mask-wearers in their network.

interactions.name: influence_interaction
interactions.description: Interaction where one person influences another to adopt mask-wearing based on social influence and connection strength.

algorithms.social_influence_calculation: Calculate influence based on weighted connections and current mask-wearing status.
algorithms.risk_perception_assignment: Assign risk perception based on age and demographic data.

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Initialize agent attributes and initial mask-wearing status.

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Define social network structure and connections.

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Validation and calibration of model parameters.

files.name: main_simulation.py
files.description: Main script to run the simulation.

files.name: entities.py
files.description: Defines the entities and their behaviors.

files.name: social_network.py
files.description: Handles the creation and management of the social network.

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Loads and preprocesses data from CSV and JSON files.

files.name: evaluation.py
files.description: Evaluates the simulation results using specified metrics.
